item.title: Ma Shoujo ~M-Otoko Zecchou Jigoku~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: M-O
  • 発売日: 2013-09-27
  • スコア: 6.38/10 (18 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 魔少女 ～M男絶頂地獄～
  • 英語名: Ma Shoujo M-Otoko Zecchou Jigoku

あらすじ

Mizuki Sakura is suddenly possessed by a girl who calls herself Ayako, and he is forced to ejaculate against his will every day.

As he was at his wit’s end, Rinne Tachikawa, an upperclassman of his school and shrine maiden, tells him that the ritual of harmony between men and women passed down through her family might be able to seal away Ayako. However, in order to do so, he must endure seven days without ejaculating despite all the temptations from Ayako.

  • 英語名: Ai Suru Musuko no Shitsukekata Mama-tachi no Otoko no Ko M Ka Kyouiku

あらすじ

Honda Shiori is worried that her beloved son Hayato is starting to become a delinquent, after being recently suspended for getting into a fight. Shiori asked her friend Chizuko for advice, who suggested that boys act out because they want attention from their mothers and enjoy being bullied by women they like. Following Chizuko’s advice, Shiori starts to give Hayato sexual discipline with love.
